name: blog-index
title: Blog index
description: Blog index page with a hero, category pills, a grid of post cards, links to more writing, and the closing call to action.
usage: The blog's index (or a category page of it). The hero takes the site Hero's props (`size="large"`, a `HeroFrame` unless `heroBackground` passes the dot field with streams, the post count's monitor as `media`, one `pill` as `actions`); `logos` (a LogoStrip) sits under it. Then the ruled section with its heading, `categories` as pills (links with `href`, a page per category as the site does, or in-place filters with `onCategoryChange` and each post's `category`), the posts as BlogCard (white and blue in turn, `tone="light"`), `links` as outline pills to guides and the archive, and `cta` (a ClosingCta) last. BlogCategoryPills is the pill row alone.
avoid: A dark band behind the posts (that is the home page's BlogSection)
More than one row of outline pills
A selected pill in blue (it is black)
notes:
The selected pill is one black surface that glides between options with the library's spring (useTabGlide); with
reduced motion it jumps. The other pills change only their fill on hover, in 200ms. Posts that do not match the selected
category are left out; a category with none shows `emptyMessage`.

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
